goal: Wave 1 build: Verifier, offline CLI, chain alerts; Compaction begin, commit and abort bracket; Stable-prefix order measured on staging (code half); Close-out and claim re-verification (code half)

slices.title: Verifier, offline CLI, chain alerts
slices.summary: Adds VerifyOrg (latest checkpoint signature, prev-hash chain, contiguous chain_seq, recomputed row hashes, head and truncation checks, attestation signature), a daily incremental and weekly full verifier loop with metrics and alerts, and the offline cmd/audit-verify CLI (exit 0 verified, 2 broken, 3 unverifiable). Reports verified, verified_with_legacy, broken, partial or key_unavailable, never a bare ok.
slices.flag: AUDIT_CHAIN_VERIFY_ENABLED (default 1 when the chain is on); AUDIT_CHAIN_VERIFY_INTERVAL

decisions_defaults.DEC-35 D1: (DEC-35 D1) Ed25519 key in env generated by `run-control-plane.sh`, public key served, external witness = SIEM copy + customer export; KMS deferred. No backfill (`legacy_unchained`). Read: owner/admin, double-checked in gateway and audit-core, plan `fe

slices.title: Compaction begin, commit and abort bracket
slices.summary: Adds a CompactionTx (begin, commit with summary digest, abort with reason) in model-gateway compaction.rs and brackets the head-summary callers in sse.rs; a timeout or failure aborts and leaves the existing dropped-history notice. An in-process guard reports begun-but-never-committed compactions older than the 6 s summary timeout, exposes mp_gateway_compaction_total{phase,outcome}, and records compaction_generation in head-summary metadata.
test_commands: [cwd: apps/Model Plane/rust] cargo test -p model-gateway --lib compaction (new a_begun_but_never_committed_compaction_is_reported_unmatched, commit_after_abort_is_refused; existing budget tests unchanged)
[cwd: apps/Model Plane/rust] cargo test -p execution-core --test compaction_parity_contract

slices.title: Stable-prefix order measured on staging (code half)
slices.summary: No code: pins the cache route to openai or azure-openai (otherwise CacheRoute::Other), runs flags-off baselines on staging (three threads of eight turns plus two Do runs), then sets MODEL_GATEWAY_CACHE_STABLE_PROMPT_ORDER=1 (optionally MODEL_GATEWAY_COMPACTION_TOKEN_BUDGET or MODEL_GATEWAY_DEDUP_CONTEXT_HISTORY, one change per run), runs the eval parity check, and records a written A/B table and the owner decision in the decisions ledger.
slices.remaining: Code half: A/B measurement script and evidence template, dry-run on the routes the dev stack already has.
test_commands: [cwd: apps/Model Plane/python/eval-lab-py] EVAL_LIVE=1 make eval (flags off vs on, 3 reruns each)
